sources.title: Wikidata English and Korean labels of companies and brands
sources.note: Structured data under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Collected by tools/lexicon/brands/collect_wikidata.py; a Korean label counts only when it is phonetically close to the written name. Labels are community data, not pronunciation authority; no synthesized audio.
